description: This file implements functions and data structures for handling X509_NAME objects in OpenSSL, including encoding, decoding, canonicalization, and memory management of X509_NAME and X509_NAME_ENTRY structures.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_new
methods.description: Initializes a new X509_NAME structure, allocating memory and setting default values.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an X509_NAME structure, including entries, buffer, and cached encoding.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_d2i
methods.description: Decodes an internal ASN.1 representation into an X509_NAME structure, handling internal cache and encoding.

methods.name: x509_name_ex_i2d
methods.description: Encodes an X509_NAME structure into ASN.1 format, utilizing cached encoding if available.

methods.name: x509_name_encode
methods.description: Generates ASN.1 encoding of the X509_NAME's entries.

methods.name: x509_name_canon
methods.description: Creates a canonical form of the X509_NAME for comparison purposes, normalizing strings and encoding.

methods.name: asn1_string_canon
methods.description: Converts ASN1_STRING to a canonical UTF8 form, normalizing spaces and case.

methods.name: i2d_name_canon
methods.description: Serializes the canonical representation of a name into DER format.

methods.name: X509_NAME_set
methods.description: Duplicates and sets a new X509_NAME, freeing the old one.

methods.name: X509_NAME_ENTRY_set
methods.description: Returns the 'set' value of an X509_NAME_ENTRY.

methods.name: X509_NAME_get0_der
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the DER-encoded form of an X509_NAME.
